description:
About the company
 Our client is a fast-growing staffing and recruiting company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Ship customer-facing functionality across the front end, server and storage, from early design through release. Work alongside product and design colleagues and contribute to product decisions as well as code. Well suited to someone who has carried new products from idea to launch in an early-stage setting.
 What you'll do
 - Create customer-facing functionality that spans the front end, server logic and data storage.
 - Own features from first investigation through to a completed release.
 - Help shape product direction by weighing in on product calls with data and design colleagues.
 - Build and maintain backend services and data models for a web application.
 - Hold work to a high standard of accuracy and polish before it goes out.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Experience carrying customer-facing functionality through every layer, from interface to storage, rather than working only on platform or pipeline code.
 - Infrastructure-heavy experience can count if it was gained as an early engineer at a startup.
 - Has started a business, joined an early startup team, or built a personal project that drew genuine users.
 - Familiarity with React or a similar front-end framework.
 - Strong technical fundamentals and a fast learning pace on unfamiliar problems.
 - Close attention to detail and a commitment to quality.
 Bonus points
 - Experience at a recruiting, job-search or two-sided marketplace startup.
 - Accelerator experience, or a project that gained wide attention on an online community platform.
 - A computer science background, preferably from a leading university; strong product engineering experience can substitute.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: $160K - $300K
 - Equity
 - Flexible time off
 - Family leave
 - Health, dental and vision coverage
 - Relocation assistance
 Location and work model
 - Cupertino, CA, United States
 - On-site, five days a week in office
 - Full-time
